definition: A report confirming that a foreign degree, diploma or certificate is authentic and stating what it is equivalent to in the Canadian education system. Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada uses ECA reports to award selection points or decide eligibility for candidates educated outside Canada.
longform: Only reports from an organisation designated by IRCC are accepted. Obtaining one can take weeks to months, and it has to exist before an Express Entry profile can be scored, which makes it a common point where applicants lose time by starting late.
